measurement_descriptions.chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape horizontal.
measurement_descriptions.waist: Measure around your natural waistline at the narrowest point.
measurement_descriptions.hip: Measure around the fullest part of your hips and seat.
measurement_descriptions.length: Measure from the highest shoulder point straight down to the hem.
measurement_descriptions.shoulder: Measure straight across the back from shoulder seam to shoulder seam.
measurement_descriptions.inseam: Measure from the crotch point down the inner leg to the ankle.
measurement_descriptions.thigh: Measure around the fullest part of the upper thigh.
measurement_descriptions.sleeve: Measure from the shoulder seam along the outer arm to the cuff.
measurement_descriptions.width: Measure across the widest part of the foot.
measurement_descriptions.foot_length: Measure from the tip of the longest toe to the back of the heel.
